        info = ydl.extract_info(f"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={vid}", download=False)
    sbs = [f for f in info['formats'] if f.get('format_id','').startswith('sb')]
    return info.get('duration'), info.get('title'), sbs

def tile_mean(t):
    w,h = t.size
    p = t.load()
    rs=gs=bs=0
    for y in range(0,h,2):
        for x in range(0,w,2):
            r,g,b=p[x,y]; rs+=r; gs+=g; bs+=b
    n=((h+1)//2)*((w+1)//2)
    return (rs/n, gs/n, bs/n)

    # YouTube pads missing storyboard tiles with a gray/colored placeholder (uniform ~128 gray or dark)
    return max(c)-min(c) < 4 and 100 <= (c[0]+c[1]+c[2])/3 <= 155
